name: sim_lint_clean
description: No forbidden token in scripts/sim (design 7.5 #2, the M1 acceptance): the kit's list and what it misses, dictionary iteration, float rounding, Engine., a vector's length(), sort_custom without a stated tie-break, .hash(), RandomNumberGenerator, await and call_deferred; TAU, PI, INF and NAN, sort() on records, get_instance_id, to_float and iterating what a function typed -> Dictionary returns. The lint itself catches each of them in a fixture and lets strings, comments, ints and allowed lines pass.

steps.msg: every forbidden line of the fixture is caught once, and nothing after them
